craft_notes: Sthāyin: nesting — breath in knowing in bare awareness. Rows: nest then throb. Read aloud: inward spiral.

lines: So numberless forth-pourings and in-pullings in one great-pouring-shaped breath —
it too in knowing, she in the adjunct, it in bare awareness —
of bare awareness alone this throb called time-rise.
l4.sanskrit_cite: evam asaṃkhyāḥ sṛṣṭipralayāḥ ekasmin mahāsṛṣṭirūpe prāṇe so 'pi saṃvidi sā upādhau sa cinmātre cinmātrasyaiva ayaṃ spando yad ayaṃ kālodayo nāma
